services.name: Audio_AcquireZ80Bus
services.behavior: Requests the Z80 bus and waits for the bus-acknowledge bit to clear.

services.name: Audio_ReleaseZ80Bus
services.behavior: Releases the Z80 bus through the bus-request control register.

services.name: Audio_LoadZ80Driver
services.behavior: Holds the Z80 in reset, copies the ROM sound driver from 0x001B8480-0x001B9D05 into 0x00A00000, clears Z80 RAM through 0x00A02000, and restores the caller status.

services.name: Audio_StartZ80
services.behavior: Releases Z80 reset, delays, releases the bus, and leaves the Z80 running.

services.name: Audio_QueueThreeBytePacket
services.behavior: Opens a protected queue transaction, writes the caller's longword one byte at a time from most-significant to least-significant order while emitting three bytes, and closes the transaction.

services.name: Audio_QueueSingleByte
services.behavior: Opens a protected queue transaction, writes one caller-supplied byte, and closes the transaction; Audio_Initialize uses it for the two bootstrap prefix bytes.

services.name: Audio_Initialize
services.behavior: Loads and starts the sound driver, then queues the initial sound-engine bootstrap commands and four caller-supplied values.

conclusion: The audio startup path has explicit bus acquisition, driver copy, Z80 start, and command bootstrap stages; the shared queue primitives remain the downstream command boundary.
